entry_points.summary: session-id subcommand: prints stable session token from $Z_HARNESS_SESSION_ID or <ppid>-<start_epoch>. Always exits 0.
register subcommand: atomically creates <active>/<run-id>.json via tmpfile+os.replace. Validates safe basename. Idempotent. Emits plan_registered. Exit 3 on failure (LOUD).
heartbeat subcommand: updates last_heartbeat/phase/current_task. If record absent, emits registry_error(reason:missing_record) and returns 0 (no-op; does NOT recreate). NON-FATAL.
update-scope subcommand: merges [{path, confidence, reason}] scope array into own record. NON-FATAL; self-logs registry_error on failure.

overlaps subcommand: path intersection of own scope vs all other live records. Exit 0: none; 10: advisory; 20: blocking (strict + explicit×explicit exact match). Emits scope_overlap_detected or active_plan_scan_complete.
reap subcommand: deletes if (a) host=localhost AND pid dead, OR (b) >2x stale threshold. Marks remote/unknown-host past 1x threshold as status:stale (no delete). NON-FATAL overall.
deregister subcommand: atomic unlink of <active>/<run-id>.json. Emits plan_deregistered. NON-FATAL; self-logs registry_error on genuine error (not on FileNotFoundError).

Five-tier base resolution with anchor enforcement. Tier 1: Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR (bypass anchor). Tiers 2-4 active when Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT=1 (default). Tier 5: pwd/z-harness. Writes/validates <git-common-dir>/.z-harness-base anchor. Emits base_resolved once per process.
Stable per-repo safe basename: <repo-basename>-<8hex> where 8hex=sha256(realpath(git-common-dir))[0:8]. All worktrees of one repo produce the same id.
Returns <base>/active-plans — the registry home. Never inline z-harness/active-plans.
Returns <base>/followups — followup-sink root. Resolves dynamically so in-flight flock fds remain stable if migration runs later.

Haiku subagent. Reads SPEC.md+PLAN.md+TASKS.md (+task block if task_id). Emits JSON [{path, confidence, reason}]. Confidence: explicit>inferred>broad>unknown. Mechanical **Files:** parse documented as offline fallback.

invariants: Lockless registry is safe ONLY because overlap is advisory — no code may make overlap a hard gate without replacing lockless delete with compare-and-delete or a registry lock.
Never invert the followup_common.py lock order — registry takes NO global lock.
Single-writer-per-record — each <run-id>.json written ONLY by the owning process; subagents RETURN data, orchestrator writes.
Base anchor enforces split-brain prevention — all processes of a repo MUST agree on base; mismatch emits base_mismatch_detected and hard-fails.
No mutation of the base while a run is live — migrate-plan-layout.sh refuses if any status:running record exists.
Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR bypasses the anchor entirely (TRUE ESCAPE HATCH); non-absolute path is a hard error.
All path construction goes through plan-path.sh helpers — inline z-harness/ literals are forbidden.
Registry keys on git-common-dir (sha256) — all linked worktrees of one repo share one registry and one base dir. No worktree-specific setup required.
gotchas: heartbeat does NOT recreate a reaped/deregistered record — if the record is absent it emits registry_error(reason:missing_record) and returns 0 as a no-op. Recreating with empty fields would pollute other sessions' overlap detection with phantom zombie records.
Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR bypasses the anchor — two sessions with different Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR values will partition their registries silently.
Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED=0 makes overlaps a silent no-op (exit 0); do not use in multi-session interactive environments.

Reaper deletes only when host=localhost AND pid is dead OR 2x stale threshold; remote hosts are never deleted (marked stale only) — a remote session's record persists until manually reaped or the session deregisters.
scope_extractor Haiku fallback (mechanical **Files:** parse) produces only explicit confidence entries — inferred/broad entries require the Haiku model.
Overlap comparison is path-string equality only (normalized repo-relative); no glob or prefix matching.

The anchor is written atomically only if absent — if two sessions race on a brand-new repo, one wins and the other reads the winner's anchor. This is correct; both independently resolve the same base tier.
Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP=1 + Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED=0 is a contradictory config: strict mode has no effect when registry is disabled. No error is emitted.
git worktree remove does not clean up the run's <base>/active-plans/<run-id>.json; the reaper handles it via the local-dead-pid check on the next run.
session-id on macOS falls back to <ppid>-<current_epoch> (no /proc); stability across repeated calls relies on the caller exporting Z_HARNESS_SESSION_ID once at run start.

record_schema_v1_fields.run_id: string — safe basename ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$; immutable after register
record_schema_v1_fields.session_id: string — session stamp from session-id subcommand
record_schema_v1_fields.repo_root: string — absolute path to main checkout (or worktree root)
record_schema_v1_fields.git_common_dir: string — absolute path to shared .git common dir
record_schema_v1_fields.worktree_path: string — absolute path to this worktree (== repo_root for main checkout)
record_schema_v1_fields.current_task: string | null — task ID currently executing
record_schema_v1_fields.scope: array of {path: string, confidence: string, reason: string}

base_fallback_chain.tier_1: $Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR — explicit absolute override; bypasses anchor; non-absolute is hard error
base_fallback_chain.tier_4: <git-common-dir>/z-harness — survives git clean; shared across all linked worktrees
base_fallback_chain.tier_5: $(pwd)/z-harness — last resort; clean-vulnerable; only active tier when Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT=0
base_fallback_chain.external_default_gate: Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT=1 (default after Phase-D flip) enables tiers 2-4; =0 restricts to tiers 1 and 5 only

Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT.effect: 1 enables tiers 2-4; 0 restricts to tiers 1 and 5 only

Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR.effect: absolute override; bypasses anchor; non-absolute is hard error

Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED.effect: 0 makes register/heartbeat/update-scope/overlaps/reap/deregister silent no-ops; list and session-id still work

Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_STALE_SECS.effect: threshold for last_heartbeat staleness; reaper deletes at 2x margin for local dead pids; marks remote as stale at 1x

Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP.effect: 1 causes explicit×explicit exact path overlap to exit 20 (blocking), which /z-implement-all treats as hard halt

overlap_exit_codes.20: Blocking overlap (explicit×explicit exact match AND strict mode active)
